title: Good Friends
text:
Anna and Tom are good friends. They have known each other since school. Every Friday, they meet at a small cafe near the park. They talk about their work, their families and their plans for the weekend.

Last year, Tom had a difficult time. He lost his job and felt very sad. Anna listened to him and helped him find a new job. Now Tom says that Anna is the most important person in his life.

questions.text: Where do Anna and Tom meet every Friday?
options: At a small cafe near the park

questions.text: What did Tom lose last year?
How does Anna probably feel about Tom?
options: She cares about him and is a loyal friend

questions.text: Why does Tom say that Anna is the most important person in his life?
options: She works in the same office as him
She supported him when he was sad
She gave him a lot of money

vocabulary.definition: paid attention to what someone was saying
hard to do or to deal with
having a big effect or value; matters a lot

paragraph_translations: Anna i Tom są dobrymi przyjaciółmi. Znają się od czasów szkoły. Co piątek spotykają się w małej kawiarni koło parku. Rozmawiają o swojej pracy, rodzinach i planach na weekend.
W zeszłym roku Tom przeżywał trudny czas. Stracił pracę i bardzo się smucił. Anna go wysłuchała i pomogła mu znaleźć nową pracę. Teraz Tom mówi, że Anna jest najważniejszą osobą w jego życiu.
